meta.title: MLBB Analyzer
meta.description: Browser-based Mobile Legends draft helper for counters, synergies, and pick planning

landing.eyebrow: Plan better picks before the match starts

hero.subtitle: MLBB Analyzer is a browser-based draft helper for Mobile Legends: Bang Bang. Find counter options for enemy heroes, explore ally combinations that fit your team, and build clearer draft intuition.

features.title: What you can do now
features.subtitle: Two core draft tools to help you prepare before the match.

counter.title: Counter Analyzer
counter.body: Select an enemy hero and review recommended counter picks. Compare options and decide what works best for your team.

synergy.title: Synergy Analyzer
synergy.body: Select an anchor hero and find ally picks that complement its strengths. Build clearer team composition ideas.

draft.title: Draft Planning Direction
draft.body: More draft tools are planned as the project grows, including broader draft guidance and role recommendations.

benefits.title: How it helps
benefits.subtitle: Practical benefits for your draft preparation.

threats.title: Understand enemy threats
threats.body: Focus on the selected enemy threat and compare ways to respond.

saferPicks.title: Compare safer picks
saferPicks.body: Review ranked counter options and choose what fits your team and playstyle.

composition.title: Think about team composition
composition.body: Explore ally combinations that work together so your draft has a clearer direction.

decisions.title: Prepare for draft decisions
decisions.body: Go into draft with a plan instead of reacting to every pick on the fly.

roadmap.title: Future direction
roadmap.subtitle: More draft tools are planned as the project grows.

draft.title: Full draft analysis
draft.body: Multi-pick reasoning that considers the whole enemy composition, not just one hero.

roles.title: Role / lane recommendations
roles.body: Suggestions tied to lane matchups and team role balance.

items.title: Item / emblem suggestions
items.body: Contextual build paths based on draft state and enemy threats.

patch.title: Patch / meta notes
patch.body: Readable summaries of patch changes that affect draft priorities.

explanations.title: Readable explanations
explanations.body: Natural-language reasoning to help you understand why a pick is recommended.

landing.footer: MLBB Analyzer is not affiliated with Moonton

counter.title: Hero Counter Analyzer
counter.subtitle: Analyze enemy hero weaknesses and reveal the strongest counter picks.
counter.footer: MLBB Counter Analyzer is not affiliated with Moonton

synergies.title: Hero Synergy Analyzer
synergies.subtitle: Find ally heroes that enable, protect, and combo well with your anchor pick.
synergies.footer: MLBB Synergy Analyzer is not affiliated with Moonton
